messages:
neha: ran a targeted recompute for nightly aggregates and hit an odd routing loop: router retried failed shards back into the same low-priority lane instead of respecting the dedupe queue backoff. console shows 7 shards stuck in 'retrying' for >45m. anyone seen this?
ravi: saw similar yesterday after the lane affinity tweak. router affinity score kept preferring the lane with the KV cache but that lane had a local throttle. we need clearer lane-fallback semantics.
sam: logs:
```
2026-03-22T02:15:10Z INFO router request_id=rc-912 selected_lane=recompute:kv-hot attempts=1
2026-03-22T02:15:11Z WARN dedupe-queue tenant=beta_inc action=throttle reason=burst
2026-03-22T02:15:12Z INFO router retrying request_id=rc-912 selected_lane=recompute:kv-hot attempts=2
```
alejandra: UX problem: console just shows "retrying" and no hint that the request is stuck due to lane-quota. users open tickets assuming platform bug. we should map lane throttles to explicit job statuses.
neha: proposal: job states include 'blocked: lane-quota' and the Console should surface the current lane and a small explainer with suggested actions (wait, re-run with fallback, contact ops). add an inline "reroute to non-kv lane" button.
ravi: on router side we should prefer different behavior: if a lane returns throttle for X seconds, silence retries to that lane for a backoff window and pick the next compatible lane. also emit an audit event when reroute happens.
sam: implementation note: add header x-recompute-routing-hint in worker response so router can learn immediate lane state. minimal change.
infra-bot: deploy planned: recompute-router v3.1.2 will include lane backoff and audit event emission. scheduling canary for 5532304800.
alejandra: add telemetry: count of "blocked: lane-quota" per tenant, average unblock time, and reroute success rate. Console tile should surface these for oncall and product.
neha: ok I'll write RFC + Console mock for the new state and button. Ravi will add the backoff logic. Sam will add header. Infra-bot, please kick the canary when ready.
infra-bot: canary scheduled at 5532304800 for tenant-set "lane-backoff-canary-10". Notifying #eng-sre and #eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
neha: thanks everyone, let's keep this behind feature flag until metrics look good. :thumbsup:
